titulo: Heart Blockage Kaise Pata Chalta Hai? 3D Animation ❤️ | Angiography Explained #shorts
descripcion:
Heart blockage ka pata kaise chalta hai? 🫀 Is video mein simple Hinglish mein samjhiye ki coronary angiography ke dauran doctor catheter ko wrist ya groin ki artery se heart ki coronary arteries tak kaise guide karte hain.

X-ray imaging ki help se blood vessels ki live images dekhi jaati hain. Phir catheter ke through special contrast dye inject kiya jata hai, jo coronary arteries mein flow karta hai. Agar artery narrow ya blocked ho, to dye ka passage restricted dikh sakta hai, jisse doctors blockage ki location aur severity ko assess kar sakte hain.
